zh: 我的征途，在那苍茫大海
en: My voyage lies across the endless sea.

zh: 想要看看我的新发明吗？
en: Want to see my new invention?

note: ⚠ 识别为“祈祷”，按语境取“启动”

en: Knowledge is the source of all power.

zh: 你永远可以相信你手中的伙伴
en: You can always trust the partner in your hands.
I've got my sights on you.

zh: 让我来斩断这虚伪的世界
en: Let me cut this false world in two.
Care for a round with me?

zh: 诅咒，可是一门必修的学问
请不要在我的课上睡觉
en: Please don't sleep in my class.

zh: 隐藏起来，寻找时机，今日致命一箭
en: Lie low, pick your moment — one lethal shot.

zh: 如果我表现得很乖，你能夸夸我吗
en: If I behave, will you praise me?

zh: 心志深沉如狼，意志坚韧如钢
en: A mind deep as a wolf, a will hard as steel.
note: ⚠ 识别严重错乱，按语境推断

en: Where my eyes reach, my blade follows.

zh: 恶魔，生活在每个人的心中
en: A demon lives in every heart.

zh: 不要玩火，小心烧到自己
en: Don't play with fire — you'll get burned.

zh: 没有人可以在我面前耀武扬威
太多的羁绊只会让自己迷惘
en: Too many bonds only blind you.
Let this longing be cut clean.

zh: 感受体内血液流失的恐惧
en: Feel the terror of your blood draining.

zh: 来自灵魂深处的治疗，怎么样
en: How about a treatment from deep in your soul?

zh: 哼，如果不能让我尽兴，便拿你祭刀
en: Hmph. If you bore me, you'll feed my blade.

zh: 呵呵呵，水花把衣服都弄湿了
en: Hehe — the splash soaked my clothes.
Time for a nice warm bath.

zh: 我盯上的目标可没有逃脱的可能
en: No target of mine ever escapes.

zh: 如果找不到祭品，可就献祭了你
en: If I find no offering, I'll sacrifice you.
The offering is ready. Begin the rite.

zh: 为了被守护的人，创造胜利的契机
en: I create the opening for those I protect.

note: ⚠ 识别为“无奈死神一生之敌”

en: Accept the blessing of the golden tree.

zh: 我的实力可不全靠魔法，大概吧
en: My strength isn't all magic... probably.
A gun is far more useful than a man.

zh: 绚丽的光芒真令人着迷
是命运之剑带你来到我身边
en: The blade of fate brought you to me.

zh: 让我为你演奏一首来自灵魂深处的乐曲
en: Let me play you a melody from the depths of the soul.
By the master's grace, the king rises.
Allow me to sing of your destruction.

zh: 需要预约一次全身检查吗
en: Shall I book you a full checkup?

zh: 成为我的新玩偶怎么样
en: How about becoming my new doll?

zh: 剪，剪，剪，我于绚丽中降临
en: Snip, snip, snip — I descend in splendor!

zh: 见识一下我最新的艺术品
迷倒你的可不仅仅是我的外表
en: It's not just my looks that charm you.
Worthy to make a pact with me?

zh: 一群被束缚的可怜家伙
失去的必将以更加狂暴的姿态讨回
en: What I lost, I'll take back with fury.

zh: 即使身处地狱，也要心向光明
en: Even in hell, I keep faith with the light.

zh: 我将成为您的守护骑士
en: I shall be your guardian knight.
Shall I light up your city?

zh: 跑吧，这样追起来才有意思

en: The sword cuts flesh — the heart cuts souls.

zh: 对于敌人而言，战争是残酷的
en: To the enemy, war is cruel.
The ocean is the origin of all things.

zh: 音乐配上魔法，真是绝妙的组合
en: Music and magic — a perfect pair.

zh: 苍茫的白色是最好的祭奠
en: The white of the wastes is the finest tribute.

zh: 天然美才是真的美，保养时间到
en: Natural beauty is true beauty — time for my regimen.
Ha ha ha ha — soul reft!
